The '''Imperial Historical Archives''' was an archive of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] until the [[Invasion of Ziost]], when it was destroyed.
